review.instruction: Verify exactly one seed unit exists for each flow named by the UAT plan and each required data family not already covered by a flow. No extra unit may pre-create the outcome under test.
Verify every unit has a unique namespace and no two units can share rows or cleanup ownership. Accounts are aliases only and no secret value appears.

Verify each unit names at least one real target store plus attribution, representative volume, expected read-back, fixture refs and exact rollback. Targets must match bound backend entities, tables or collections.

failurePolicy: Record the exact uncovered family, namespace collision, invalid target or incomplete rollback. Revise only affected units, then reassess all coverage and isolation; never execute seeds during planning.
